title: On the product of cross-intersecting families with maximal covering number
summary: For integers $k ,\ell \geq 2$ let $m(k,\ell)$ denote the maximum of $|\mathcal{F}| |\mathcal{G}|$ where the maximum is taken over all pairs of cross-intersecting families, $\mathcal{F}$ being a $k$-graph with covering number $\ell$ and $\mathcal{G}$ a $\ell$-graph with covering number $k$ (see the paper for the definitions). Erdos and Lovasz initiated the study of the one family version. That is, they provided lower and upper bounds on the maximal size $m(k)=|\mathcal{F}|$ where $\mathcal{F}$ is an intersecting k-graph with covering number $k$.
